q: A tutor taught □ lessons on Monday and ○ lessons on Tuesday. Each lesson lasted △ minutes. On each of the two days, she also spent 15 minutes getting ready. Which expression represents the total amount of time, in minutes, the tutor spent on both days?

topic: Finding Area/Perimeter of Rectangle, given Length & Width
q: The width of a rectangle is one fourth of its length. The perimeter of the rectangle is 50 meters. What is the length of the rectangle?
key: Answer: C. Width : length = 1 : 4, so one width and one length make 5 equal parts. One width + one length = half the perimeter = 25 meters.
